ASP.NET Core and Blazor

Helpers for ASP.NET Core applications and Blazor clients: CRUD service bases, composite localization, JavaScript interop and MudBlazor components.

Packages

Package What it does Builds on
AspNetCore ASP.NET Core helpers including composite localization. —
AspNetCore.Blazor Blazor helpers including JavaScript interop services for clipboard, localStorage, sessionStorage, loading indicator, file download, and exit confirmation, plus a camera capture component. —
AspNetCore.Blazor.MudBlazor MudBlazor helpers including converters, validators, and server-paged table base component. AspNetCore.Blazor, Common, Data
AspNetCore.EntityFrameworkCore Entity Framework Core service base classes with CRUD operations and database migration helpers for ASP.NET Core. AspNetCore, Data.EntityFrameworkCore
